# Acceptable use policy

See [terms](../glossary/terms.md) for definitions.

## Prohibited uses
Attempting to bypass rate limits ([usage limits](../products/usage-limits.md)), reselling access, probing other customers' workspaces, or uploading unlawful content.

## Enforcement
A first violation gets a written warning. Repeated or severe violations lead to suspension. A suspension for abuse can remove refund eligibility under the [refund policy](refund-policy.md).
